record_type_quote: In the present article we report a rather direct replication of an experiment reported by Rayner, Balota, and Pollatsek (1986).

targets.authors: Rayner, K., Balota, D. A., Pollatsek, A.
targets.title: Against parafoveal semantic preprocessing during eye fixations in reading
targets.evidence_quote: Here, we examined this specific issue via a rather direct replication (i.e., same subject pool, same eye-tracking system, and same stimuli) of Rayner et al. (1986).
targets.outcome_quote: In a close replication of Rayner et al. (1986), we found no evidence of semantic preview benefit. Thus, with respect to the issue implicitly raised by Hohenstein and Kliegl (2013), the results reported by Rayner et al. are replicable.

reasoning: A different participant sample re-tests the 1986 paper, using observations collected in the earlier Drieghe study. The authors give an explicit overall confirmation; other cited preview studies supply background rather than additional targets.
